_comment: Per-suite ceilings for defects that are NOT ordinary failures. A crash, a hang and a file the parser cannot read are each a different thing from 'the runtime returned the wrong answer', and averaged into a four-digit fail count all three are invisible. tools/check-defect-budget.mjs enforces these against the committed report.
_directions: crashes is exact (it must match, in both directions — they are rare and individually known). timeouts and parseFailures are ceilings: they may drop without ceremony, but never rise.

known: crash: test-signal-args.js sends itself SIGINT; milojs has no process.on('SIGINT'), so the default action kills it
timeouts: sampled cases sat past 45s against a 10s limit, so these are hangs, not slowness
